hypothesis: After E95 the herds seed fewer patches (0.017 to 0.008 per 1000 ticks, a rate with no denominator, so a real fall) and feed hunters a smaller share of the meat (0.030 to 0.016, partly diluted: its denominator is all meat eaten), while lineage dominance rose (0.21 to 0.30). Herds that graze a patch briefly and move on (herdStayTicks, herdLeaveShare), gentler trampling (trampleDamage) or a smaller exclusion disc (herdRadius) keep the herds roles and cut their cost to blobs. Design note for the code lever, not in this screen: herdRadius couples the rigid exclusion in trample.js (size + herdRadius) with the plant reach in herd-graze.js (herdRadius + food radius). A separate herdBodyRadius (default equal to herdRadius so nothing moves, int the same range) used only by trample.js and the ray occlusion in ray-gather.js would let the body shrink while grazing keeps its reach. It needs a config key with a rule in config-herds.js, goldens unchanged at the default, failing tests first (a blob at herdRadius from a herd animal with herdBodyRadius 40 is not pushed; graze reach unchanged), and is built only if radius50 shows the disc is the cost.
